name: Scenario M: Appointment Reminder (24hr Before)
comments: Triggered by a Calendly invitee.created webhook (hook 3030). A dynamic Sleep waits until exactly 24 hours before the event start time. Claude (OpenRouter) writes a 3-sentence professional reminder email. Resend delivers the reminder to the invitee. A HubSpot note records that the reminder was sent. Error route sends an internal alert via Resend. All secrets are stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. No vendor branding is exposed to the client (white-label). Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Receives all Calendly webhook payloads on hook 3030. The filter passes only invitee.created events so rescheduled, canceled, or other event types are ignored. Calendly payload paths: payload.payload.invitee.name, payload.payload.invitee.email, payload.payload.event_type.name, payload.payload.event.start_time (ISO-8601 with UTC offset).

Dynamic sleep that calculates the number of seconds to wait so execution resumes exactly 24 hours before the event. Formula: subtract(subtract(parseDate(start_time); 86400); now). If the booking is made less than 24 hours before the event the result will be negative or zero and Make.com will proceed immediately without error.

Calls OpenRouter with model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. System prompt sets the tone to short and professional. User prompt requests exactly 3 sentences addressed to the invitee by name, referencing the event name, mentioning they can reply to reschedule. Only the email body is returned — no subject or greeting boilerplate. temperature 0.5 for consistent, professional output.

Sends the reminder email via Resend. FROM is constructed as 'env.RESEND_FROM_NAME <env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS>' for a professional display. TO is the Calendly invitee email from the webhook payload. Subject is fixed: 'Your appointment tomorrow'. Body is Claude's 3-sentence output from module 3. White-label: no CWI AI branding in any user-visible field.

Creates a HubSpot note (CRM object) recording that a 24-hour reminder was sent. hs_timestamp is set to now(). Note body includes invitee name, email, event type name, event start time, and an Eastern Time timestamp. Authenticated via env.HUBSPOT_API_KEY private app token with crm.objects.notes.write scope. In production, associate this note to the matching HubSpot contact using the associations endpoint after creation.

Error-route module. Fires when any upstream module (2–5) throws an unhandled error. Sends a plain-text alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL from env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS via Resend. Alert includes the failed module ID, error type, error message, invitee details, event start time, and timestamp so the admin can manually send the reminder or follow up.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.label: OpenRouter API Key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Used to authenticate calls to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions.

RESEND_API_KEY.label: Resend API Key
RESEND_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_API_KEY. Used for all outbound email sends via https://api.resend.com/emails.

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS.label: Resend From Address
RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS. Verified sender email used in the FROM field on reminder emails to invitees. Must be a Resend-verified domain address.

RESEND_FROM_NAME.label: Resend From Display Name
RESEND_FROM_NAME.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_FROM_NAME. Display name shown alongside env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS in the FROM field, e.g. 'Your Scheduling Team'. Must be white-label safe — no CWI AI mention.

CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.label: Internal Alert From Address
CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.notes: Referenced as env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Verified Resend sender address used as FROM on internal error-alert emails. Never exposed to clients.

ADMIN_EMAIL.label: Admin Email Address
ADMIN_EMAIL.notes: Referenced as env.ADMIN_EMAIL. Destination address for error alerts and operational notifications.

HUBSPOT_API_KEY.label: HubSpot Private App Token
HUBSPOT_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.HUBSPOT_API_KEY. HubSpot private app access token with crm.objects.notes.write scope.

notes.label: Module 1 — Calendly Invitee Created Webhook Trigger
notes.note: Uses CustomWebHook hook 3030. Fires on every Calendly webhook POST. The filter passes only payloads where body.event == 'invitee.created', dropping canceled, rescheduled, and other event types. Key payload paths: payload.payload.invitee.name, payload.payload.invitee.email, payload.payload.event_type.name, payload.payload.event.start_time.

notes.label: Module 2 — Dynamic Sleep Until 24 Hours Before Event
notes.note: builtin:Sleep with a dynamically computed delay. Formula: subtract(subtract(parseDate(start_time; 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ'); 86400); now). This yields the seconds remaining until 24 hours before the event. If the booking is made within 24 hours of the event, the delay will be zero or negative and Make.com proceeds immediately.

notes.label: Module 3 — OpenRouter / Claude: Write Reminder Email
notes.note: Calls anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 via OpenRouter. System prompt enforces a short professional tone. User prompt requests exactly 3 sentences: acknowledges the appointment tomorrow, names the event, and mentions the invitee can reply to reschedule. Only the email body text is returned. temperature 0.5 for consistent professional output.

notes.label: Module 4 — Resend: Send Reminder Email
notes.note: Sends the Claude-written body to the Calendly invitee email. FROM is 'env.RESEND_FROM_NAME <env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS>'. Subject is fixed: 'Your appointment tomorrow'. Body is Claude's 3-sentence output. White-label: no CWI AI branding in any user-visible field.

notes.label: Module 5 — HubSpot: Log Reminder Sent Note
notes.note: POSTs a new note to HubSpot CRM (crm/v3/objects/notes). Records that the 24-hour reminder was sent with invitee name, email, Calendly event type, event start time, and an Eastern Time timestamp. In production, associate this note to the matching HubSpot contact using the associations endpoint after creation.

notes.label: Module 6 — Error Route: Resend Alert
notes.note: Attached as the error handler for the scenario. On any unhandled error in modules 2–5, sends a plain-text alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL from env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Alert includes failed module ID, error type, error message, full invitee and event context, and timestamp so the admin can manually send the reminder or follow up.
